name: Agentic Ai Action Level Accountability
text: Agentic AI governance should be organized around action level accountability. A governance roadmap is incomplete unless it can reconstruct the agent action, delegated mandate, evidence used, review path, and downstream effect.
scope_conditions: Agentic AI systems with delegated authority where actions, evidence, review, and downstream effects can be recorded.
